critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/notifications.py: _HIDDEN_KINDS list is complete and matches spec verbatim (all 19 kinds). _KIND_NOT_HIDDEN applied to /unread-count, /list, /mark-seen, AND emit_notification — defense in depth (producer side AND read side). Hidden rows are NEVER flipped to seen by mark-seen, so they cannot resurface even if the filter is bypassed later.

frontend/src/pages/Messages.jsx: TABS array order is correct ['chats','groups','realms','calls']; CallsTab is a pure render with NO useEffect/fetch — guaranteed no /api/calls/* traffic. Empty component (testid='calls-empty') receives both title and body strings exactly per spec.

frontend/src/pages/Notifications.jsx: HIDDEN_KINDS Set is a defensive client-side filter on both the mock NOTIFICATIONS array AND the merged server list — even if the backend filter ever fails, the UI would still skip hidden kinds. Header uses `flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3` + `min-w-0` on the title block and `shrink-0 self-start sm:self-auto` on the Mark-All-Read button, which wraps the button below at <480px and keeps it inline at >=640px — no overlap at 360, 375, or 768. Title `<span>` uses no truncation classes, so 'Notifications' always renders in full.
frontend/src/data/mockData.js: NOTIFICATIONS array and NOTIFICATION_CATEGORIES both fully purged of 'Marketplace' and 'Wallet' — no client-side cleanup pass needed.
